title: F.A. Cup Final 1965: soccer honours its greatest star
brief_description: A record of the 1965 FA Cup Final between two of England’s most famous soccer clubs, Liverpool and Leeds. Includes some background material on Sir Stanley Matthews, showing him with footballers from overseas who were visiting England to participate in celebrations marking his retirement from football and the Queen presenting the Cup.
